tasks.title: PULSE NOT_READY → READY_WITH_CAVEATS: triage orphan routes
tasks.prompt:

MISSION: Implement Parte 9 (L8 of docs/audit/lacunas-identificadas.md): get PULSE out of NOT_CERTIFIED / NOT_READY by triaging graph-route-caller-unobserved routes.

FILES TO READ:
- artifacts/pulse/PULSE_REPORT.md and artifacts/pulse/*.json (latest)
- backend/src/**/*.controller.ts to identify the orphan routes

FILES YOU OWN:
- docs/api/external-routes.md (new — register routes used by curl/integration/webhook callers)
- docs/audit/lacunas-identificadas.md (UPDATE — add frontend-incomplete bucket as debt)
- backend/src/**/*.controller.ts (only for routes that are HISTORICAL ORPHANS — remove them)
- AUDIT_FEATURE_MATRIX.md (update statuses)

- scripts/pulse/*
- ops/*
- scripts/ops/*

STEPS:
1. Run PULSE once to refresh state:
     npx ts-node --project scripts/pulse/tsconfig.json scripts/pulse/index.ts --report 2>&1 | tail -40
   If this fails because of a workspace issue, capture the error and continue with existing PULSE_REPORT.md.
2. Extract the list of graph-route-caller-unobserved routes from PULSE artifacts (likely artifacts/pulse/findings.jsonl or PULSE_REPORT.md).

5. If PULSE manifests have a way to ACCEPT externals (look at scripts/pulse for accept-list semantics), point to docs/api/external-routes.md from PULSE config WITHOUT editing scripts/pulse/* — if no mechanism exists, document the gap in lacunas as L13.

- chore(backend): remove historical orphan controller routes
- docs(audit): mark frontend-incomplete routes as documented debt

  model DecisionOutcome {

tasks.title: Economic hierarchy attribution in decision trace
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never git restore.

MISSION: Implement Parte 10: orchestrator decision trace carries reference to which point of the economic hierarchy was decisive in the choice.

HIERARCHY (ordered):
1. compliance — never sacrificed
2. margin — incremental margin > vanity conversion
3. conversion — incremental conversion > message volume
4. retention — retention > sale that generates refund
5. ux — lead experience > aggressive insistence
6. learning — exploration under low risk
7. exploration — never violates consent/channel/cost/reputation

FILES TO READ:
- backend/src/kloel/commercial-decision-orchestrator.service.ts
- backend/src/kloel/mind-decision-baselines.ts
- backend/src/kloel/brain-event-spine.service.ts

FILES YOU OWN:
- backend/src/kloel/economic-hierarchy.ts (new — pure helpers)
- backend/src/kloel/economic-hierarchy.spec.ts (new)
- backend/src/kloel/commercial-decision-orchestrator.service.ts (attach justification to decisions)
- backend/src/kloel/commercial-decision-orchestrator.service.spec.ts (assert presence + value)

SPEC:
export type HierarchyLevel = 'compliance' | 'margin' | 'conversion' | 'retention' | 'ux' | 'learning' | 'exploration';

export function attributeHierarchy(decision: {
  type: string;
  chosen: string;
  context: Record<string, unknown>;
  channelConfig?: Record<string, unknown>;
}): { level: HierarchyLevel; reason: string };

RULES (deterministic, encoded — no LLM):
- If decision is human_transfer with 'trust_objection' or 'fatigue_risk' → ux.
- If apply_discount with discountPercent > channelMaxDiscount → blocked (compliance/margin) — but if within bounds and product margin still positive → margin.
- If pure proactive_outbound past daily limit → blocked compliance.
- If chosen action was upper-bound aggressiveness when ceiling allowed → bounded by ux (the ceiling = ux-driven cap).
- If audio chosen because arsenal exists AND audioRatio prior says lead prefers audio → ux (lead experience).
- If product_offer is highest_margin variant chosen → margin.
- If 'top_seller' chosen due to high replied_rate prior → conversion.
- If aggressiveness escalated (within ceiling) due to imminent_purchase concept → conversion.
- If chosen variant has confidence < 0.5 but baseline was equal — recorded as learning (we are exploring within low-risk window).
- Default fallback when nothing applies → 'conversion'.

ORCHESTRATOR INTEGRATION:
- After each decision (audio_vs_text, tone, aggressiveness, etc), attach result.hierarchyJustification = attributeHierarchy(...). Put in decisions[decisionType].hierarchyJustification.
- The trace in BrainEventSpine 'commercial.decision.taken' includes the justification.

VALIDATION:
  cd backend && npx jest --testPathPatterns='economic-hierarchy|commercial-decision-orchestrator' --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -20
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10

COMMITS:
- feat(kloel): economic hierarchy attribution helper (P10)
- feat(orchestrator): attach hierarchyJustification to each decision trace

FINAL REPORT: list of rules implemented, test count, sample trace JSON snippet.
